channel.title: PackagingDive – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from PackagingDive – Bias and Credibility (packagingdive.com)

item.title: Aptar announces CEO transition
item.description: A fellow 30-year veteran of the company, who leads the company’s fast-growing pharma business, will take over when Stephan Tanda retires later this year.

item.title: California’s recyclability labeling law under fire in new lawsuit
item.description: The Flexible Packaging Association and the American Forest & Paper Association are among the plaintiffs seeking a preliminary injunction to block enforcement of SB 343 come October.

item.title: Prescription bottle recycling a real pill for the industry
item.description: Not many pill bottles are getting recycled in the U.S. despite being made of commonly recyclable material. A new Closed Loop Partners report calls for collaboration across the value chain to increase pill bottle recycling rates.

item.title: The Iran war is hitting packaging supply chains. Are the impacts temporary?
item.description: Higher fuel and material costs, shipping disruptions and consumer spending are playing into industry impacts. Certain packaging substrates, such as plastics, bear a greater burden than others.

item.title: AI-powered platform aims to speed packaging chats and sales
item.description: Matthew Wright, the founder of Specright, wants to create a new digital home for the packaging industry via Forest, an AI-powered platform that’s being designed to streamline new connections and transactions.

item.title: Manufacturing job openings increased to nearly 500K in January
item.description: The Bureau of Labor Statistics also released revised data from December 2025, including 10,000 fewer separations than initially reported.

item.title: International Paper to build $225M box plant in Mississippi
item.description: The new build will replace a nearby aging facility. This aligns with IP’s plan for $1.9 billion in annual capital spending, especially to reconfigure its box plant network.

item.title: CAA preparing for California EPR on compressed timeline
item.description: SB 54 regulations are still yet to be finalized. Circular Action Alliance will submit its program plan by June 15. The PRO has received more than 2,000 producer reports, but notes some producers are holding out.

item.title: Spring surprise? Containerboard prices reverse course in March.
item.description: For the second consecutive month, some observers reported surprise at a containerboard pricing index’s movement. The March increase reinforces expectations that producers will target another price hike this year.

item.title: 13 North American packaging manufacturers announce expansions
item.description: Cascades, ePac, International Paper, Lindenmeyr Monroe and Rand-Whitney were among the packaging companies that announced expansions.
